title: It is said that: пассив с глаголами мнения

theory.md: Чтобы передать слухи и мнения, говорят **It is said / believed / thought that…** или **He is said to + глагол**. It **is said that** the forest talks. = The forest **is said to talk**. О прошлом: He **is believed to have left** — считается, что он ушёл.

cells: It is said that a spirit lives here.
A spirit is said to live here.
X is said to have + V3
Rory is said to have built a hut.

theory.md: Не «It says that the forest talks» про слухи: it says — «написано» (в тексте, на табличке).

examples.es: It is said that the trees can talk.
The keeper is believed to be very old.
Rory is thought to have gone home.
It is known that owls hunt at night.

options: A spirit is said to live in the forest.
A spirit says to live in the forest.
A spirit is said living in the forest.
He is believed to have left.
He is believed to leave yesterday.

exercises.sentence: It ___ that the castle was built in a single night.
exercises.ru: Говорят, что замок построили за одну ночь.

exercises.sentence: The old oak is thought ___ five hundred years old.
exercises.ru: Считается, что старому дубу пятьсот лет.

exercises.statement: «She is said to have won the competition» — о прошлом.
«It says that the forest talks» — обычный способ передать слух.
«He is known to be honest» — правильно.

exercises.answer: The forest is said to be dangerous

exercises.sentence: Rory is believed ___ (leave) the city last spring.
exercises.ru: Считается, что Рори покинул город прошлой весной.
